summary: Server hosting admin platform with complete dashboard for managing dedicated servers and subscription plans, Stripe integration for payments, and admin authentication system
architectural_notes: Frontend: React + TypeScript with Tailwind CSS
Authentication: Internet Identity with first admin auto-assignment
Payments: Stripe API integration for subscription management
Admin panel with server and subscription plan CRUD operations
Flexible server assignment model supporting both direct user assignment and plan-based assignment
known_issues: First admin not being recognized after sign-in (needs authentication logic fix)

existing_features.title: Create an admin dashboard page that displays comprehensive lists of all dedicated servers with their current status, specifications, and assignment information
Implement server creation functionality allowing admins to create new dedicated servers by specifying name, specifications (CPU cores, RAM GB, storage GB), and initial status

Implement server assignment functionality allowing admins to assign servers to specific user accounts or to subscription plans, with the flexibility to choose either assignment type based on customer needs
Implement server deletion functionality allowing admins to permanently remove servers from the system with confirmation to prevent accidental deletion
Create a subscription plans management interface displaying all plans with their pricing, specifications, and billing periods, accessible from the admin dashboard

Implement plan creation and editing functionality allowing admins to define subscription plans with name, price, server specifications (CPU cores, RAM GB, storage GB), and billing period (monthly, quarterly, annually)
Integrate Stripe API for payment processing, allowing admins to configure Stripe secret key and for users to purchase subscription plans through Stripe checkout

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix first admin authentication recognition on sign-in
Build admin dashboard displaying lists of servers and plans with management capabilities
Implement server management (create, assign to users, delete, view status)
Implement plan management (create plans with name, price, CPU/RAM/storage specs, billing period)
Integrate Stripe API for subscription plan purchases and payment processing
Implement flexible server assignment (to user accounts or purchased plans/subscriptions)
Fix the first admin authentication logic so that the first user to sign in with Internet Identity is automatically recognized and granted admin status without requiring an invitation code
